risk_note: RV2 settlement (B2-04zf; D10-467 ③ / D10-477 / D10-492; BR-FUND-04, BR-TEXT-09). settle.run_done: published when all batches of a settle run are DONE (outcome done) or the execution stops on the switch with a PARTIAL / paused batch (outcome partial); an execution with no credit publishes nothing and does not bump part. Per D10-492 part / last_outcome / part_started_at live in settlement's own app.settle_runs (B2-04zfa, migration 0108): first publish INSERT … ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, later publishes a row_version CAS, all on the publishing transaction under a transaction advisory lock on (app, settle_run_id); a CAS / insert that misses publishes nothing; the code never reads event_log. The old event_log implementation (r1–r4) was dropped. Payload {settle_run_id, bill_id, part, outcome, batch_count}.
